title: utkal.toml
description: A Kalinga project managed by utkal.

name.description: Package name: letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Other projects import it by this name.

version.description: This package's version, e.g. "0.1.0". Tag releases as `v0.1.0` so others can ask for versions.

kalinga.description: The Kalinga version the package is written for, e.g. "0.4".

dependencies.description: Kalinga packages, imported with `import "name"` or `import "name" as alias`.

path.description: A folder holding the package's utkal.toml, relative to this file.

git.description: Git repository URL (or a local repository path).

branch.description: A branch; `utkal update` moves to its newest commit.

version.description: A version requirement matched against tags: "0.4" (= ^0.4), "~1.2.3", "=1.0.0", ">=0.3" or "*".

rust-dependencies.description: crates.io crates the Rust code (`use rust` files, `= rust { }` bodies) can use, without `use crate` lines.
